-- Absolue de Tubéreuse - Méthyl benzoate
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 15.0, 1, 'stable', 'Note florale crémeuse caractéristique'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-ABS-005' AND m.name LIKE '%Benzoate%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Absolue de Fleur d'Oranger - Linalol
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 30.0, 1, 'stable', 'Note florale douce et miellée'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-ABS-006' AND m.name LIKE '%Linalol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;
